mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, slot_id, status, request_id, created_at, expire_at FROM reservation WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, slot_id, status, request_id, created_at, expire_at FROM reservation WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT * FROM reservation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation ( user_id, slot_id, status, request_id, created_at, expire_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{slotId}, #{status}, #{requestId}, #{createdAt}, #{expireAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET status = #{newStatus} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE resource_slot SET status = 'RESERVED' WHERE id = #{slotId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE'
UPDATE resource_slot SET status = 'AVAILABLE' WHERE id = #{slotId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
UPDATE reservation SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE reservation SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND expire_at IS NOT NULL AND expire_at > NOW(3)
